provenance.prompt: Purpose: four real wall-mounted makeup mirrors, targetProfileId makeup-mirror-wall, targetProfileVersion 1. Adapt the pinned project-authored tabletop heads in metres, +Y up and +Z toward the room. Remove base/post, translate retained vertices by [0,-.365,.038], add a closed .16 x .24 x .02m mounting plate with back Z=0, retain finite pane contours and fixed three-plane wings. Preserve wall mounting, warm-white spotlight and separate emissive housing. Bake identity transforms. Budget 2500 triangles/32 meshes/four materials. The measured Kenney candidate lacks the required pane and lamp mapping. Rebuild through the pinned exporter and validate actual loaded GLBs through the independent gate. Record source identities, frame edit, failures and limits. Design: A wall-mounted .40 x .36m rectangular pane with broad cream metal ring, closed back and overhead diffuser. A real closed wall plate supports the full fixture.
provenance.method: Adapted pinned original mirror head with base/post removed, rigid translation and a new closed wall mounting plate. Finite joint correction replaces overlapping lamp joints with face contacts and trims tri-fold rims at fixed angle-bisector seams. Pane/back/light transforms and main contours remain from the pinned source. Finite convex pane contours and distinct tri-fold plane transforms are baked into Float32 resource-space vertices. Deterministic GLTFExporter with actual GLTFLoader readback and independent wall-makeup-mirror geometry admission.
limitations: Broad fixed frame and overhead warm-white diffuser. No variable color temperature.
Wall-mounted source adaptation. Real wall/reflection/illumination require separate runtime evidence.
